families.name: Ashvein Goblinkin
families.inspiration: D&D / Pathfinder goblin, hobgoblin and bugbear
families.lore: Goblins whose dormant GKOM woke in the ash of burned camps. They hoard crystal chips like coin; the more crystal they swallow, the larger and more organised they become, until a warlord commands whole warbands.

forms.flavor: Only a few smoky crystals betray the corruption beneath its skin.
forms.crystal: a few small growths to scattered clusters

forms.name: Ashvein Hobgoblin

forms.crystal: crusted joints and spine to plated shoulders, back and limbs

forms.name: Ashvein Bugbrute
forms.flavor: A hulking ambusher that drags prey into the dark by the ankle.
forms.crystal: half the body armoured in crystal

forms.name: Ashvein Warlord

forms.crystal: most of the body sheathed to crystal hide with bare seams

families.name: Shardlings

forms.crystal: a few small growths to scattered clusters
